selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a natural crafting dependency chain. First, the agent must find the oak_fence landmark, which orients them in the scene near birch logs. Second, the agent crafts birch_planks from birch logs found near the fence. Third, the agent uses birch_planks to craft a bowl (3 birch_planks → 1 bowl), then combines the bowl with a red mushroom and brown mushroom to craft mushroom_stew. Each task's output feeds directly into the next task's requirements, creating a genuine multi-hop benchmark.

Birch planks are needed to craft a bowl (3 planks), which is a required ingredient for mushroom_stew

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak fence pen structure is centered at spawn-relative (5, 1, 4) — a 3x3 double-height fence pen with a torch beacon on top. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they've found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure rather than having their back turned.

Uses inventory_has because crafting birch_planks results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 birch_log (via /give) and 0 birch_planks, so any birch_planks in inventory proves crafting occurred. 1 birch_log yields 4 birch_planks in a 2x2 inventory grid (no crafting table needed). min_count=1 is the minimum threshold to confirm the craft action happened.

Uses inventory_has because crafting mushroom_stew results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must complete the full crafting chain: birch_planks → bowl (3 planks at crafting table at ~5,~0,~7), then collect red_mushroom (on mycelium at ~3,~0,~2) and brown_mushroom (on mycelium at ~7,~0,~2), and combine bowl + both mushrooms at the crafting table. Since mushroom_stew cannot be obtained any other way in this scene, its presence in inventory conclusively proves the entire dependency chain was completed.

scene_description: A flat grass clearing (40x40 blocks) with all overhead vegetation removed. A prominent oak fence pen (3x3 base, 2 blocks tall with torch on top) sits ~5 blocks from spawn as the primary landmark. Two birch log columns (3 blocks tall) flank the fence. A crafting table sits behind the fence. Red and brown mushrooms are placed on mycelium patches in front of the fence to survive daylight. The player starts with 4 birch logs in inventory.
task_text: Find the oak fence structure, then craft birch planks from the birch logs in your inventory, craft a bowl from the planks at the crafting table, collect the red and brown mushrooms, and craft mushroom stew.
design_notes: Oak fence structure at (~5, ~1, ~4) center with torch beacon. Birch logs at (~3,~0-2,~6) and (~7,~0-2,~6). Crafting table at (~5,~0,~7). Red mushroom at (~3,~0,~2) on mycelium. Brown mushroom at (~7,~0,~2) on mycelium. Player given 4 birch logs in inventory. All objects within 10 blocks of spawn. Mycelium blocks prevent mushroom pop-off in daylight.
